summary: @servicetitan/assist-utils preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares itself as a small React/MobX hooks library and ships a 222-byte re-export at dist/index.js as its `main`, but its real behavior is in the `preinstall` lifecycle script. `package.json` runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated loader (obfuscator.io-style `_0x*` identifiers, per-function string dictionaries) that downloads the Bun runtime zip from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array rotation, opcode/dictionary indirection, hex-mangled identifiers) with no source, tests, or documentation and no relation to the advertised React/MobX purpose. Running the payload under Bun rather than Node evades Node-based install-time sandboxing and scanners. The scoped name `@servicetitan/assist-utils` mimics an internal ServiceTitan namespace, consistent with a scope/dependency-confusion delivery. Installing this package results in execution of attacker-controlled, unpinned-to-purpose obfuscated code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
